name: io.purchasely.huawei.PLYHuaweiActivity
description: Purchasely opens this Activity for Huawei AppGallery purchase or update results; it reads the result and returns the purchase state to Purchasely.
disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent Huawei purchase outcomes from reaching Purchasely, so Huawei-billed subscriptions may fail to complete or update.
